# Sanad — UAE e-invoicing (EIS) phase checker

URL: https://sanad.attenciona.com/
Language: EN · Market: UAE (VAT-registered businesses)
Category: Regulatory compliance checker
Verified: 13 August 2026

## What it does
Checks which phase of the UAE Electronic Invoicing System (EIS) applies to a business and
stamps its ASP-appointment deadline and mandatory e-invoicing date with a live countdown.
Runs entirely in the browser (no server, no data collection).

## The pain (active today)
- Pilot + voluntary adoption live since 01/07/2026.
- Phase 1 (annual revenue ≥ AED 50M): appoint an FTA-accredited ASP by 30/10/2026
  (extended once from 31/07/2026); mandatory e-invoicing (B2B/B2G) from 01/01/2027.
- Phase 2 (below AED 50M): ASP by 31/03/2027; mandatory from 01/07/2027. Government: 01/10/2027.
- Penalties (Cabinet Decision 106/2025): AED 5,000/month without ASP; AED 100 per missing
  e-invoice (cap AED 5,000/month); AED 1,000/day for unreported system failures or data changes.
- PDFs, emails and scans are NOT e-invoices: only structured data via an accredited provider.

## Tool logic
- Q1 VAT-registered? No → NOT IN SCOPE.
- Q1 yes, Q3 B2B/B2G? No → B2C ONLY (out of scope for now).
- Q1 yes, Q3 yes, Q2 revenue ≥ AED 50M → PHASE 1 (ASP 30.10.2026, e-invoicing 01.01.2027).
- Q1 yes, Q3 yes, Q2 below AED 50M → PHASE 2 (ASP 31.03.2027, e-invoicing 01.07.2027).
